ib_intro: Unanswered Instagram comments from the last 14 days. AI suggests replies in your brand voice; you edit, confirm and send every reply. Nothing is sent automatically.
ib_refresh_errors: Comments could not be fetched for {n} posts
ib_refresh_demo: Demo mode: comments come from sample data
ib_empty: No comments waiting for a reply
ib_empty_hint: Comments arrive with sync when comment sync is on (Settings → Sync), or press "Refresh comments".
ib_ai_disabled: AI is off for this account; write the reply yourself.
ib_reply_placeholder: Write your reply or pick a suggestion…
ib_confirm_body: This reply will be posted publicly from @{account} to @{user}'s comment:
ib_confirm_demo: Demo mode: sending is simulated, nothing reaches Instagram.
exp_intro: Instagram has no true split test for captions. Here you publish caption variants as separate posts and compare each post with the account's usual results for that post type. Results are directional, not proof.
exp_empty_hint: Pick one variable (e.g. question hooks) and add at least 3 posts to each arm.
exp_planned_hint: Planned posts join the results once they are published and synced.
exp_need_arms: Enter a name and add at least one post to each arm.
exp_verdict_need_more_hint: Each arm needs at least {n} synced posts older than 72 hours.
exp_verdict_inconclusive_hint: The 90% confidence intervals overlap: the difference may be noise.
exp_verdict_directional_hint: Arm {a}'s 90% confidence interval does not overlap the others. This is still not a randomized test; topic, day and time differences can affect it.
exp_lift_hint: Lift 1.00 = the account's 90-day average for the same post type.
exp_delete_confirm: Delete this experiment? Posts are not affected.
exp_summarize_hint: Only numbers and short captions are sent; no account names.
